content_sections.heading: IISER Bhopal Recruitment 2026 at a Glance

rows.details: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Bhopal (IISER Bhopal)
Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF), DST, Government of India
6 months, or until completion of the project
Junior Research Fellow (JRF) or Project Associate-I
Rs. 37,000 + HRA for JRF; Rs. 30,000 + HRA for Project Associate-I

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The official notification does not state the exact number of vacancies available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) and Project Associate-I positions.

rows.essential_qualification: M.Sc. / MS / BS-MS / BS / BTech or equivalent in Physics, Engineering Sciences, Applied Mathematics, Biophysics, or Physical Chemistry with a minimum of 60% aggregate or a CGPA/CPI of 7.0 on a 10-point scale. Valid score/rank in NET/GATE/JEST or an equivalent national eligibility test (students from national institutes like IISERs, IITs, NITs, IISc with a CPI above 8.0/10.0 are exempt).
rows.desirable_qualification: Proficiency in computer programming (Python or any other programming/scripting language).

rows.essential_qualification: M.Sc. / MS / BS-MS / BS / BTech or equivalent in Physics, Engineering Sciences, Applied Mathematics, Biophysics, or Physical Chemistry with a minimum of 60% aggregate or a CGPA/CPI of 7.0 on a 10-point scale (without NET/GATE/JEST qualification).
rows.desirable_qualification: Proficiency in computer programming (Python or any other programming/scripting language).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The duration of the project position is 6 months or until completion of the project, subject to satisfactory performance. There may be an opportunity to convert this project position into an institute-funded PhD in the near future. Monthly emoluments are INR 37,000 plus HRA as applicable for Junior Research Fellow (JRF) candidates with NET/GATE/JEST or equivalent qualification, and INR 30,000 plus HRA as applicable for Project Associate-I candidates without NET/GATE/JEST qualification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IISER Bhopal Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare all required application documents combined into a single PDF file. Draft an email addressed to [email protected] containing the application materials. Attach the single PDF file including your cover letter, detailed CV, names and email addresses of two referees, copies of academic credentials from 10+2 onwards, and proof of NET/GATE/JEST qualification where applicable. Send the email on or before 14 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted by email for an online interview conducted via Zoom or Google Meet. No interim correspondence will be entertained.

faq.question: Q1. Are HRA and allowances paid in addition to the monthly fellowship amount?
faq.answer: Yes, the monthly salary includes HRA as applicable, with Rs. 37,000 plus HRA for JRF and Rs. 30,000 plus HRA for Project Associate-I.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible for exemption from the NET/GATE/JEST requirement for the JRF position?
faq.answer: Students from national institutes including IISERs, IITs, NITs, and IISc who hold a CPI above 8.0 out of 10.0 are exempt from the NET/GATE/JEST requirement.

faq.question: Q3. How will the interview be conducted for shortlisted candidates?
faq.answer: The interview will be conducted online via Zoom or Google Meet for shortlisted candidates only.

faq.question: Q4. What specific desirable qualifications are mentioned in the notification?
faq.answer: Proficiency in computer programming, specifically in Python or any other programming or scripting language, is listed as a desirable qualification.

faq.question: Q5. Which documents must be included in the single PDF application file?
faq.answer: The single PDF file must include a cover letter, a detailed CV, names and email addresses of two referees, copies of all academic credentials including mark sheets from 10+2 onwards, and proof of NET/GATE/JEST or equivalent qualification where applicable.
